items.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024
items.q: You know Maria Schneider said something along those lines.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know I think we’re all affected by what happens to us in life you know. Every little detail of how we live, you know, I was going to say imposes its way into our psyche. But that sounds a little negative. Everything we do in life, whether we’re shopping for groceries or whatever, inside this flesh is a spirit. And I’m no different now than when I’m playing music. It’s the same, it’s the same spirit. So whatever I collect in my life, when I’m not playing my instrument, comes out when I am playing my…

You know Maria Schneider said something along those lines. She encouraged her students to not be so one-sided about just music, like live your life. And you have to be a full person in order to create something meaningful.

Yeah. That’s right. In my situation when I became a — when I made a commitment to Christianity, to Christ, then there’s a Scripture that says, “I know my sheep and my sheep know my voice, and no man can pluck them out of my hand.” My life was following the Lord and so I could do choices I made I could make with confidence in my life. It wasn’t just half-assed, or, there was, Jesus is called the light of the world. So you know I don’t think of my faith as a feeling. When I think of feeling I think of a blind man…
